# core/process

`core/process` — running a child process with its input given and its
output collected. Every child vector starts goes through `runProcess`.

Generated from [src/core/process.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/core/process.ts).

### runProcess

Runs `argv` with `stdin` as its input and waits for it to exit, killing it
with SIGKILL once `timeoutMs` has passed. A child that runs out of time is
still `Ok`, with `timedOut` set and the output it wrote before the kill.

```ts
function runProcess(
  argv: string[],
  stdin: string,
  timeoutMs: i32,
): Result<ProcessResult, string>
```

<scalar-field name="argv" type="string[]" required>

the program and its arguments; `argv[0]` is looked up on PATH

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="stdin" type="string" required>

the text written to the child's standard input

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="timeoutMs" type="i32" required>

the most milliseconds the child may run

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Result&lt;ProcessResult, string&gt;">

`Ok` with what the child did (`timedOut` when the limit killed it),
  or `Err` when it could not be run or wrote more than 16 MiB

</scalar-field>
